# AYORAI ATTRACTOR

> AYORAI ATTRACTOR is a Brazilian open-source project for evidence-based technical auditing of artificial intelligence answers. It verifies AI answers at the level of each individual claim: it relates each claim to evidence and provenance, analyzes whether the evidence supports, contradicts or does not clarify the claim, and a deterministic Judge with versioned rules issues the final verdict. Author, maintainer and technical director: Anderson Leon Ayora. License: Apache-2.0.

O AYORAI ATTRACTOR é um projeto brasileiro open source de auditoria técnica de respostas de inteligência artificial baseada em evidências, de autoria de Anderson Leon Ayora. Lema: "Da afirmação à evidência. Da evidência a um resultado verificável."

Core principle / Princípio fundamental: Intelligence ≠ Authorization ≠ Execution (Inteligência ≠ Autorização ≠ Execução). Models may assist the analysis but are not the authority for the final verdict; the deterministic Judge applies the system's explicit contract.

Judge 2.0 verdicts: SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, UNVERIFIED, REFUTED, CONFLICTING.

Current version: 0.8.0. GitHub Release: https://github.com/Ayorinha/ayorai-opensearch/releases/tag/v0.8.0. Previous version DOI (v0.7.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24045951. Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23125082. Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13.

Status and limits: v0.8.0 adds document APIs POST /v1/check (claim verification against text or text-layer PDFs, evidence offsets and page references, UNVERIFIED abstention) and POST /v1/fields (comparison of money, date, CPF/CNPJ, number and text fields against a document), plus trace identity and dependency-chain hardening. The release adds strict CI dependency auditing, a separately audited NLI environment with CycloneDX SBOM, no persisted GitHub credentials in workflow checkouts, and job-scoped write permissions. No new confirmatory accuracy result is reported; benchmark work in this release is exploratory DEV only and split TEST was not used. The v0.7.0 official LTT result remains 0/11 under the originally registered rule; the Amendment 2 re-aggregation is post-hoc and exploratory. There is no Portuguese-language benchmark result; the RGC protocol is proposed and not frozen. The project is not certified, does not guarantee detection of every hallucination, and does not by itself establish regulatory compliance. Hashes verify artifact integrity, not content truth.
